# Per-top pT regression on the trained pairwise model (ttbar, large dataset).
#
# GENERATED by kube/render_massreg_job.py : edit the scripts under
# src/data/delphes/ and re-render, do not hand-edit the embedded python.
#
# Why pT and not mass: generation fixes the top mass (set param_card mass 6
# 172.5), so per-event parton mass varies only by the Breit-Wigner width, order
# 1.3 GeV, against a 3-jet mass resolution of order 15 GeV. That target is a
# constant in disguise. Top pT spans hundreds of GeV, its truth is already in
# the file as TARGETS/<particle>/pt, and it is directly comparable to the pT
# curves we already produce. Mass follows once this path is proven, with the
# gen-jet triplet mass as the target.
#
# No SPANet fork: dprim7/SPANet@feat/pairwise-attention already parses
# REGRESSIONS, builds RegressionDecoder, and supports --state_dict (strict=False)
# plus --freeze_state_dict, which is exactly "bolt a head onto trained weights".
#
# The job refuses to reach the GPU until preflight passes: the event file
# parses, every parsed regression key exists in the h5, and the checkpoint
# supplies the non-regression weights.
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: dp-massreg-pt
  namespace: axol1tl
  labels:
    jobgroup: spatop-job-train
spec:
  backoffLimit: 2
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 172800
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        job-name: dp-massreg-pt
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 0
        fsGroup: 0
      affinity:
        nodeAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            nodeSelectorTerms:
            - matchExpressions:
              - key: nvidia.com/gpu.product
                operator: In
                values:
                - NVIDIA-A100-SXM4-80GB
                - NVIDIA-A100-PCIE-40GB
                - NVIDIA-A100-SXM4-40GB
      containers:
      - name: training
        image: gitlab-registry.nrp-nautilus.io/mquinnan/top-spanet:spatop-container
        command:
        - /bin/bash
        - -c
        - |
          set -e

          SCRIPTS=/data/spatop/scripts
          WORK=/data/spatop/massreg
          mkdir -p $SCRIPTS $WORK

          echo "########## 0. INSTALL ##########"
          pip install -q git+https://github.com/dprim7/SPANet.git@feat/pairwise-attention
          pip install -q tensorboard rich

          echo "########## 1. WRITE DATA SCRIPTS ##########"
